## What changed

Describe the behavior and the API consumer impact.

## Why

Link the issue or provide a minimal baseline/candidate example.

## Verification

- [ ] Added or updated automated tests
- [ ] Ran `pnpm check`
- [ ] Updated rule or user documentation when behavior changed
- [ ] Confirmed that no credentials, private specifications, generated reports, or analysis history are included

## Compatibility checklist

- [ ] Request and response directions were considered separately
- [ ] False-positive and false-negative cases were considered
- [ ] Severity, evidence, and remediation remain explainable
- [ ] AI output cannot change the deterministic score, severity, or CI exit code
